nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) holding token balances of each account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) holding spending allowances.
Private uint256 total token supply, set to 10000000000000 in the constructor.
Private uint8 number of decimals, set to 6 in the constructor.
Private string token name, set to 'Shiba Inu Algorithmic Stablecoin' in the constructor.
Private string token symbol, set to 'USDI' in the constructor.
Private payable address of the contract owner, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
Constructor that initializes all token metadata, mints the total supply to the owner and pre-approves a router address.
Public view function returning the token name from _name.
Public view function returning the token symbol from _symbol.
Public view function returning the token decimals from _decimals.
Public view override function returning _totalSupply.
Public view override function returning _balances[account].
Public override transfer that moves tokens from msg.sender to recipient via _transfer.
Public view override function returning _allowances[owner][spender].
Public override approve that sets an allowance for msg.sender via _approve.
Public override transferFrom that uses allowance and calls _transfer and _approve.
Internal transfer routine that mutates _balances and emits a Transfer event.
Internal approval routine that mutates _allowances and emits an Approval event.
msg.sender used in the constructor to set _owner and to seed the allowance mapping.
msg.sender used as the token sender in the public transfer function.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner in the public approve function.
msg.sender used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
Unchecked arithmetic 'currentAllowance - amount' inside transferFrom; underflow protection relies on the preceding require.
Unchecked arithmetic 'senderBalance - amount' inside _transfer; underflow protection relies on the preceding require.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the token symbol into _symbol.

Constructor writes 6 into _decimals.
Constructor writes the initial supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the owner address into _owner.
Constructor mints the total supply into _balances[_owner].
Constructor pre-approves the router address in _allowances.
Constructor consumes msg.sender to derive _owner.

balanceOf() reads _balances for the given account.
allowance() reads the nested _allowances mapping.
transfer() delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the sender argument.
approve() delegates execution to the internal _approve routine.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom() invokes the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() invokes the internal _approve routine to decrease allowance.

transferFrom() reads _allowances[sender][msg.sender].

transferFrom() performs an unchecked subtraction on the allowance.
_transfer() mutates _balances for sender and recipient.

_transfer() performs an unchecked subtraction on the sender balance.
_approve() writes the allowance into _allowances.
currentAllowance flows into the unchecked subtraction expression.
senderBalance flows into the unchecked subtraction expression.
